name: BMR.NET
summary: Raymond Terrace dial-up ISP + web hosting; acquired by C&N/CNN Internet ~2001-02 (ROBERTS, BRYCE MARTIN (sole trader), ABN 46 256 749 209).

events.details: BMR.NET Internet Services, Raymond Terrace; earliest Wayback capture Dec 1998.

Acquired by C&N/CNN Internet (Techcel); homepage live to Apr 2001, collapsed to a stub by Mar 2002. Retail site died between Apr and Dec 2001 on the CNN Internet (Techcel) takeover, so late 2001 rather than c. 2001-02.

refs.label: full retail ISP homepage live 29 Apr 2001
by Dec 2001 (and again Mar 2002) the domain was only a meta-refresh to the CNN Internet webmail login - webmail-only = dead
